Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a plan to place automatic external defibrillators in public high schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to automatic external defibrillators in publicschools; adding a new section to chapter 28A.210 RCW; and creating newsections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that suddencardiac arrest is the leading single cause of death in the UnitedStates, accounting for more than three hundred twentyfive thousanddeaths each year. Effective cardiopulmonary resuscitation, includingdefibrillation, that is provided immediately after cardiac arrest candouble a victim's chance of survival. Survival rates drop seven to tenpercent for each minute without defibrillation. (2) The legislature further finds that on many days, as much astwenty percent of the nation's combined adult and child population canbe found in a school. Installation of an automatic externaldefibrillator is one component of an overall school medical emergencyresponse plan recommended by the American heart association. (3) Therefore the legislature intends to protect the health andlives of the state's citizens by ensuring that automatic external p. 1 HB 1429defibrillators are placed in each public high school and by providingthe funding necessary to phase in this requirement by the 2010 schoolyear.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.210RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The office of the superintendent of public instruction shalldevelop a plan to phase in the placement of automatic externaldefibrillators in all public high schools in the state by September 1,2010. Between September 1, 2007, and September 1, 2010, the plan shallrequire an increasing number of public high schools in each successiveyear to have an automatic external defibrillator located in the school. (2) Subject to funding provided for the purposes of this section,school district boards of directors shall: (a) Provide for the placement of an automatic externaldefibrillator in each public high school in the district according tothe plan developed by the office of the superintendent of publicinstruction; (b) Ensure that the automatic external defibrillator is placed ina prominent location and is readily accessible during the school dayand for extracurricular activities such as sporting events outside theschool day; (c) Comply with the requirements of RCW 70.54.310, includingtraining of personnel, use of the defibrillator, and notification ofthe local emergency medical services organization about the location ofthe defibrillator; and (d) Include instruction in the use of the defibrillator in stafftraining and the health and fitness curriculum. (3) For the purposes of this section, "high school" includes anypublic school that enrolls students in grades ten, eleven, or twelve.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2007, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
